summary: iter-57 covers the Staff App Attendance redesign: new GET /api/attendance/my-monthly, updated POST /api/attendance/self (structured 400 out-of-geofence + is_late + office_distance_m), Home CHECK IN inline sheet (no redirect), and monthly-calendar Attendance tab. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS (calendar shape + week-off + summary reconciliation + holiday surfacing + mark-today-then-present, out-of-geofence structured detail shape, office_distance_m persistence, is_late boolean, plus /api/staff + /api/attendance/my + HR staff search regressions from iter-56). Frontend (mobile 390x844, logged in as autostaff_1782322458@example.com): Home renders ready-for-work card and clicking the quick punch button opens [data-testid=checkin-sheet] inline WITHOUT changing URL. Attendance tab renders all required testids: att-today-banner, att-month-toolbar, att-month-label ('Aug 2026'), att-prev-month, att-next-month, att-summary-strip (sum-present/absent/half/paid-leave/week-off all present), att-weekday-header (7 cols Sun-Sat), att-calendar-grid with 31 tiles att-day-1..att-day-31. Today tile (Aug 25) has red ring, Sundays render gray (week_off), Aug 15 renders pink (holiday), 24 past unmarked working days render as absent, and clicking a tile opens att-date-detail dialog. Month prev/next navigation updates the label and grid correctly (Aug 2026 -> Jul 2026 -> Aug 2026). Backend geofence structured 400 confirmed via pytest; the browser could not exercise the check-in -> out-of-range UI transition because our own successful backend test had already marked today 'present', so Home surfaced quick-check-out (not quick-check-in) and att-open-checkin was correctly hidden per code. This is an expected consequence of test ordering, not a bug; main agent can re-verify by clearing today's row and repeating.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — a11y polish, non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: main agent to re-verify Home CHECK IN -> out-of-range UI transition manually. Requires today's attendance row to NOT yet exist for autostaff_1782322458 (or use a fresh staff account) so the Home shows quick-check-in and the CheckInFlowSheet drives location -> selfie -> capture -> structured 400 -> checkin-step-out-of-range. Backend structured 400 payload is verified working, so this is purely a UI visual verification.
Optional: add aria-describedby (or DialogDescription child) to the att-date-detail DialogContent to silence the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py my_attendance_monthly (line 4958): correctly excludes _id via projection and returns a plain dict — good. Priority order (attendance row > approved leave > holiday > week_off > future > absent) matches spec. Summary bucket lumps holiday under week_off which matches the screenshot semantics but is a subtle behavior — worth calling out in API docs.

server.py self_check_in (line 4791): structured HTTPException(400, {code, distance_m, radius_m, site_name, message}) works but note FastAPI wraps the dict inside {'detail': {...}} — frontend must read err.response.data.detail.code (confirmed in CheckIn.jsx).

is_late computation uses datetime.now(timezone.utc).astimezone(BUSINESS_TZ) for the current time but compares against shift.start_time HH:MM in IST — correct. If shift_id is missing, is_late stays False (no penalty) as spec requires.
server.py is now 19,042 lines — still overdue for router extraction (repeat flag from iter-55/iter-56).

CheckIn.jsx AttendanceTab summary-strip does not surface a 'holiday' tile even though holidays are counted under week_off — acceptable per spec, but user may find it confusing that pink-tinted holiday tiles increment the 'Week Off' counter.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all required testids present, calendar renders correctly, month nav + modal work; out-of-range UI transition not exercised due to today already-present state)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend attendance calendar + self check-in structured errors are stable. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter57_attendance_calendar.py is a good regression baseline going forward. To re-test the check-in out-of-range UI end-to-end: (1) delete today's attendance row for autostaff_1782322458 via Mongo or an admin endpoint, (2) log in on /check-in, (3) grant geolocation with Ranchi coords (23.3441, 85.3096), (4) click quick-check-in -> location -> selfie -> capture -> should transition to [data-testid=checkin-step-out-of-range] with the 'X meters away' message and a Refresh Location button. Playwright cannot supply a real camera stream, so canvas.toBlob may fail on the selfie capture even when in-range — this is a known Playwright limitation, not a product bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration. The one 'FAIL' printed by the Playwright script ('expected out-of-range after capture but not shown') is a test-orchestration artifact: the previously-run backend test test_mark_today_then_reflected_present had marked today's attendance as present, so Home rendered the check-OUT sheet (which does not enforce geofence + does not include the out-of-range UI transition) instead of the check-IN sheet. Backend structured 400 handling is separately verified as passing (test_out_of_geofence_returns_structured_400).
